long_biography.plain_text:
Ellertson began as a serial software founder, creating businesses in document automation, development tools and network management. He later became a turnaround chief executive at Interleaf, then ran online-banking pioneer S1 and web-performance company Gomez. At Gomez, he guided the business to its acquisition by Compuware.

He next co-founded CloudFloor and merged it into Everbridge, becoming the emergency-communications company's chief executive. Under his leadership, Everbridge broadened into critical-event-management software and completed a public offering in 2016. Ellertson now applies that operating experience at Akmazo Capital, a firm he co-founded to take active majority positions in growing software-as-a-service businesses.
